description: The batter steps down the pitch and lofts the ball straight over the sightscreen.
commentary: SIX! Aarav dances down the track and launches it straight over the sightscreen!

description: The batter pulls a short delivery high over deep mid-wicket.
commentary: Into the stands! Rohan rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for six!

description: The batter gets underneath a full delivery and sends it over long-on.
commentary: Kane gets underneath it and clears long-on! A towering six at a crucial stage!

description: The batter sweeps a spin delivery over the square-leg boundary.
commentary: Babar brings out the slog sweep and sends the spinner over the rope! SIX!

description: The batter drives a full toss over the long-off boundary.
commentary: Jos makes room and launches the full toss over long-off! That is a clean six!

description: The batter hooks a bouncer over the fine-leg boundary.
commentary: David takes on the short ball and hooks it over fine leg! The ball sails into the crowd!

description: The batter clears the front leg and swings a slower ball over deep cover.
commentary: What timing from Suryakumar! He clears his front leg and sends the slower ball over deep cover for six!

description: The batter uses his feet and hits the ball over the bowler's head.
commentary: Kusal charges down and sends it straight back over the bowler's head! SIX runs!

description: The batter finishes a powerful pull shot beyond the deep-square boundary.
commentary: Glenn muscles the pull shot into the stands at deep square leg!

description: The batter swings through the line and sends the final ball over the boundary.
commentary: A huge finish to the over! Hardik swings through the line and clears the boundary for six!

description: The batter drives the ball through extra cover and it reaches the boundary.
commentary: Timed beautifully! Aarav threads the gap at extra cover and the ball races away for FOUR!

description: The batter cuts a short and wide delivery behind point.
commentary: Width offered and punished! Rohan cuts hard behind point for four runs.

description: The batter flicks the ball through mid-wicket to the rope.
commentary: A lovely wristy flick from Kane! It beats the fielders and reaches the boundary.

description: The batter edges the ball past the slips and it runs away for four.
commentary: A thick edge flies past the slip cordon and races to the third-man boundary!

description: The batter sweeps the spinner fine and beats the fielder at short fine leg.
commentary: Jos gets down low and sweeps it fine! No one can stop that boundary.

description: The batter punches a back-of-a-length ball through cover.
commentary: David stays tall and punches it through cover. A crisp shot and four more!

description: The batter drives straight and the ball beats the bowler and mid-off.
commentary: Suryakumar presents the full face of the bat and drives straight for four!

description: The batter pulls the short ball along the ground to the square-leg boundary.
commentary: Kusal swivels and keeps the pull along the ground. It reaches the square-leg fence!

description: The batter guides the ball past backward point for a boundary.
commentary: Glenn opens the face and guides it past backward point. FOUR runs added!

description: The batter lofts a controlled shot over the infield and it rolls to the boundary.
commentary: Hardik clears the infield with a controlled lofted shot and collects four!

description: The bowler beats the batter's defence and knocks over the off stump.
commentary: BOWLED HIM! The delivery beats Aarav's defence and sends the off stump flying!

description: The batter edges a delivery to the wicketkeeper, who takes a clean catch.
commentary: A faint edge and safely taken! Rohan has to go as the wicketkeeper completes the catch.

description: The batter attempts a big shot but holes out to deep mid-wicket.
commentary: Taken in the deep! Kane goes for the big hit but finds the fielder at deep mid-wicket.

description: The bowler traps the batter in front and the umpire raises a finger.
commentary: LBW! The ball strikes Babar in front and the umpire's finger goes up. A key breakthrough!

description: A direct hit catches the non-striker short of the crease.
commentary: Direct hit! Jos is short of his ground and the run-out is confirmed. Sharp work in the field!

description: The batter tries to sweep but misses and is bowled.
commentary: Cleaned up! David misses the sweep and the ball crashes into the stumps.

description: The batter nicks a rising delivery and a slip fielder takes the catch.
commentary: A sharp catch in the slips! Suryakumar gets a touch on the rising delivery and departs.

description: The batter is stumped after stepping out and missing the ball.
commentary: Stumped! Kusal charges down, misses the ball, and the keeper removes the bails in a flash.

description: The batter mistimes a lofted shot and is caught at long-off.
commentary: Straight to long-off! Glenn cannot get the distance and the fielder takes it safely.

description: The bowler gets a late swing that takes the inside edge onto the stumps.
commentary: What a delivery to finish the over! The inside edge sends the ball onto the stumps and Hardik is out.

description: The batter blocks a good-length delivery back to the bowler.
commentary: Solid defence from Aarav. He blocks it back to the bowler and no run is taken.

description: The batter leaves a delivery outside off stump and the keeper collects it.
commentary: Well judged by Rohan, who lets it pass outside off. No run from that delivery.

description: The bowler beats the outside edge with a ball that moves away.
commentary: A beauty from the bowler! It moves away and beats Kane's outside edge. Dot ball.

description: The batter defends a spin delivery carefully into the pitch.
commentary: Babar watches it closely and defends into the pitch. The bowler keeps the pressure on.

description: The batter attempts a drive but the ball is stopped by the bowler.
commentary: Jos goes for the drive, but the bowler gets a hand to it. No run added.

description: The batter ducks under a short delivery.
commentary: David gets underneath the short ball and leaves it alone. A dot to the total.

description: The batter checks a shot and the ball drops safely near the crease.
commentary: Suryakumar checks the shot at the last moment. The ball drops safely and they stay put.

description: The batter plays a forward defensive shot against the spinner.
commentary: A watchful forward defence from Kusal. The spinner completes a tidy dot ball.

description: The batter cannot beat the close-in fielder with a gentle push.
commentary: Glenn nudges it into the infield, but the fielder moves quickly. No run.

description: The batter shoulders arms to a delivery outside the off stump.
commentary: Hardik judges the line and leaves it alone. The over continues with a dot ball.

description: The batter taps the ball into the leg side and completes one run.
commentary: Aarav works it into the leg side and they jog through for a single.

description: The batter guides the ball towards third man for one run.
commentary: A deft guide towards third man. Rohan keeps the strike with a single.

description: The batter pushes a full delivery towards mid-off and runs quickly.
commentary: Kane pushes it towards mid-off and sets off immediately. One run taken!

description: The batter nudges a spin delivery into the gap at mid-wicket.
commentary: A soft touch into the mid-wicket gap and Babar rotates the strike.

description: The batter drops the ball near cover and completes a quick single.
commentary: A quick call and a sharp run! Jos drops it near cover and makes it safely.

description: The batter plays the ball down to long-on for one run.
commentary: David pushes it down to long-on and takes the easy single.

description: The batter steers a short ball into the off side and takes one.
commentary: Suryakumar steers it into the off side and picks up a single. Good strike rotation.

description: The batter clips the ball behind square for one run.
commentary: A neat clip behind square and Kusal is off the mark with a single.

description: The batter defends with soft hands and runs after the ball rolls away.
commentary: Soft hands from Glenn allow the ball to roll into space. They take one run.

description: The batter works the ball to deep square leg and settles for a single.
commentary: Hardik places it into the deep and takes one. The strike rotates again.

description: The batter drives into the wide outfield and completes two runs.
commentary: Aarav finds the gap in the deep and they come back for two. Excellent running!

description: The batter pulls the ball into the deep and turns quickly for a second run.
commentary: Rohan pulls it into the deep and pushes hard for two. Both runs completed safely.

description: The batter places a cover drive wide of the fielder and runs twice.
commentary: Kane finds the cover gap and turns one into two with quick running.

description: The batter clips the ball towards deep mid-wicket and completes two.
commentary: A well-placed clip into the deep mid-wicket region. They race back for the second.

description: The batter cuts the ball behind point and runs two before it is returned.
commentary: Jos cuts late and finds space behind point. Two runs picked up before the throw comes in.

description: The batter lofts the ball into a gap and completes a comfortable two.
commentary: David lifts it into the open space and they stroll back for two runs.

description: The batter sweeps the ball to deep square and sprints back for a second.
commentary: A sweep into the deep and superb urgency between the wickets. Two more to the total!

description: The batter pushes the ball wide of long-off and completes two runs.
commentary: Kusal places it wide of long-off and gets back for two. Smart placement.

description: The batter drives through the gap at extra cover and runs two.
commentary: Glenn drives through extra cover and turns it into a couple with alert running.

description: The batter pulls the ball into the deep and slides home for the second run.
commentary: Hardik pulls it into the deep and dives to make his ground. Two runs completed!

description: The bowler sends the ball well outside the off-stump wide line.
commentary: Too wide outside off! The umpire signals a wide and India receive an extra run.

description: The bowler sprays a delivery down the leg side beyond the batter's reach.
commentary: Down the leg side and out of reach. Wide called, adding an extra to the total.

description: The spinner loses control and sends the ball well down the leg side.
commentary: The spinner misses the line by a distance. The umpire calls wide.

description: The bowler attempts a yorker but sends it outside the wide marker.
commentary: The yorker misses its target and goes beyond the wide line. An extra run for Pakistan.

description: The bowler delivers a ball too far outside off stump while the batter moves across.
commentary: Jos moves across, but the ball is still too far outside the line. Wide signalled.

description: The bowler sends a slower ball down the leg side.
commentary: A slower ball slips down leg and the umpire stretches both arms. Wide called.

description: The wicketkeeper collects a delivery that passes well outside the batter's reach.
commentary: The keeper has to move across to collect it. That's another wide to the bowling side.

description: The bowler overcompensates for a previous leg-side delivery and misses outside off.
commentary: The bowler searches for the off-side line but sends it too wide. One extra run.

description: The ball slips from the bowler's hand and travels outside the marked line.
commentary: That one slips away from the bowler and is called wide. The batting side gets an extra.

description: A delivery passes outside the wide line as the batter attempts a late movement.
commentary: The ball misses the wide marker despite the batter's movement. Wide signalled by the umpire.

description: The bowler oversteps the popping crease while delivering the ball.
commentary: No-ball! The bowler has overstepped the crease and India are awarded an extra run.

description: The bowler delivers a high full toss above the batter's waist.
commentary: That's above waist height! The umpire calls no-ball and the batting side gets an extra.

description: The bowler oversteps while attempting a yorker at the end of the innings.
commentary: A costly overstep at the death! No-ball called and New Zealand receive an extra delivery.

description: The bowler delivers a high full toss that reaches the batter above waist height.
commentary: The full toss is too high and the umpire signals no-ball. A free hit may follow under the format rules.

description: The bowler's front foot lands beyond the crease during the delivery stride.
commentary: The front foot is over the line! No-ball called, giving England an extra run.

description: The bowler releases a high full toss while trying a slower delivery.
commentary: The slower ball comes out too high. The umpire calls no-ball for the dangerous full toss.

description: The bowler oversteps while attempting to dismiss the batter with a full delivery.
commentary: A front-foot fault denies the bowling side a legal delivery. No-ball signalled.

description: The bowler delivers a waist-high full toss that the batter pulls away.
commentary: Kusal pulls it away, but the umpire has already called no-ball for height.

description: The bowler's front foot crosses the line during a short-pitched delivery.
commentary: The bowler has overstepped! No-ball called and another run is added.

description: The bowler sends down an illegal delivery after losing balance in the stride.
commentary: An expensive error under pressure! The delivery is called no-ball and the batting side gets another chance.

description: The batter reaches fifty runs by steering a single into the off side.
commentary: FIFTY FOR AARAV! He guides the ball into the off side and brings up a well-earned half-century.

description: The batter completes a half-century with a boundary through cover.
commentary: A superb milestone! Rohan drives through cover for four and raises his bat for a fifty.

description: The batter reaches fifty with a quick single after working the ball to mid-wicket.
commentary: That's his fifty! Kane takes a quick single and reaches the milestone with a valuable contribution.

description: The batter brings up a half-century with a pull shot to the boundary.
commentary: FIFTY! Babar rocks back and pulls it to the rope to complete his half-century.

description: The batter reaches fifty after a controlled drive for two runs.
commentary: Jos gets back for two and brings up a composed fifty. A strong platform for England.

description: The batter completes fifty with a late cut past point for four.
commentary: A classy late cut races away for four, and David moves to a well-played half-century!

description: The batter reaches the half-century mark with a single to long-on.
commentary: Suryakumar takes one to long-on and brings up fifty. The crowd appreciates an entertaining innings.

description: The batter reaches fifty after guiding a ball to third man for a single.
commentary: A single to third man completes Kusal's half-century. A useful innings for Sri Lanka.

description: The batter reaches fifty with a powerful straight drive for four.
commentary: Glenn drills it straight back past the bowler for four and celebrates his fifty!

description: The batter completes a fifty with a flick into the leg-side gap.
commentary: A neat flick brings up Hardik's half-century. He has timed his innings well.

description: The batter reaches one hundred with a boundary through extra cover.
commentary: A HUNDRED FOR AARAV! He drives through extra cover to reach a magnificent century!

description: The batter completes a century with a single into the deep.
commentary: ROHAN REACHES THREE FIGURES! A single into the deep brings up a superb hundred.

description: The batter reaches one hundred with a pull shot for four.
commentary: Kane pulls it firmly to the boundary and raises his bat for a brilliant century!

description: The batter brings up a century by lofting a full delivery over mid-off for four.
commentary: A glorious shot to reach the landmark! Babar clears mid-off and completes a memorable hundred.

description: The batter completes a century with a pair of runs into the wide outfield.
commentary: Two more runs and Jos has his hundred! A superbly paced innings reaches three figures.

description: The batter reaches a century with a straight drive that beats the fielders.
commentary: David drives straight and races through for the runs. A magnificent century under pressure!

description: The batter brings up one hundred with a sweep to the boundary.
commentary: Suryakumar sweeps it fine for four and reaches a stunning hundred!

description: The batter reaches a century after turning the ball into the leg side for a single.
commentary: A single completes Kusal's century! He acknowledges the applause for a fine innings.

description: The batter completes one hundred with a boundary through backward point.
commentary: Glenn opens the face and finds the backward-point boundary. That's his century!

description: The batter reaches the century mark with a lofted shot over extra cover.
commentary: Hardik goes over extra cover and reaches three figures in style. What an innings!
